item.title: spectra-cobra
item.description: SPECTRA checks flux consistency and reconstructs metabolic networks at a range of biological scales: minimal reactomes, context-specific models, gap-filled reconstructions, minimal microbiomes, microbial community models and multi-tissue models. What changes between them is the universal model, the evidence supplied (omics evidence) and the objective chosen.
